meanings.en: a plant with brightly colored, exotic flowers
meanings.exampleEn: She received a beautiful purple orchid for her birthday.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğum günü için güzel bir mor orkide aldı.

meanings.en: a person who plans and arranges an event or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The organizer of the conference welcomed all the guests.
meanings.exampleTr: Konferansın organizatörü tüm misafirleri karşıladı.

meanings.en: the quality of being new and unique
meanings.exampleEn: The judges praised the originality of her design.
meanings.exampleTr: Jüri, tasarımının özgünlüğünü övdü.

meanings.en: in the beginning; at first
meanings.exampleEn: The house was originally built in the 18th century.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev başlangıçta 18. yüzyılda inşa edilmişti.

meanings.en: to begin or come from a particular place or source
meanings.exampleEn: The tradition is believed to originate in ancient China.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu geleneğin antik Çin'den kaynaklandığına inanılır.

meanings.en: an object used as decoration
meanings.exampleEn: They hung shiny ornaments on the Christmas tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Noel ağacına parlak süsler astılar.

meanings.en: a unit of weight equal to about 28 grams
meanings.exampleEn: The recipe calls for four ounces of butter.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarif dört ons tereyağı gerektiriyor.

meanings.en: the remote, sparsely populated interior of Australia
meanings.exampleEn: They drove for days through the Australian outback.
meanings.exampleTr: Avustralya'nın ıssız iç bölgelerinde günlerce araba sürdüler.

meanings.en: the sudden start of something unpleasant, such as disease or war
meanings.exampleEn: The outbreak of the disease spread quickly across the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın patlak vermesi bölge genelinde hızla yayıldı.

meanings.en: the final result of an action or process
meanings.exampleEn: Nobody could predict the outcome of the election.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiç kimse seçimin sonucunu tahmin edemedi.

meanings.en: to go faster or further than others, leaving them behind
meanings.exampleEn: The runner managed to outdistance all her competitors.
meanings.exampleTr: Koşucu tüm rakiplerini geride bırakmayı başardı.

meanings.en: to do better than someone else
meanings.exampleEn: He always tries to outdo his older brother at everything.
meanings.exampleTr: Her konuda ağabeyini geçmeye çalışır.

meanings.en: a set of clothes worn together
meanings.exampleEn: She bought a new outfit for the wedding.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün için yeni bir kıyafet aldı.

meanings.en: to grow too big or too old for something
meanings.exampleEn: The children quickly outgrow their shoes.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar ayakkabılarına çabucak büyüyüp sığmaz oluyor.

meanings.en: a short trip taken for pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: The whole class went on an outing to the museum.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün sınıf müzeye bir geziye gitti.

meanings.en: a means of expression, a place that sells goods, or an electrical socket
meanings.exampleEn: Painting is a good outlet for her emotions.
meanings.exampleTr: Resim, duyguları için iyi bir çıkış yoludur.

meanings.en: a general description or plan showing the main features
meanings.exampleEn: She gave us a brief outline of her new project.
meanings.exampleTr: Bize yeni projesinin kısa bir taslağını verdi.

meanings.tr: daha uzun yaşamak, ömrü uzun gelmek
meanings.en: to live longer than someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She outlived her husband by twenty years.
meanings.exampleTr: Kocasından yirmi yıl daha uzun yaşadı.

meanings.en: a person's point of view or the likely future situation
meanings.exampleEn: He has a positive outlook on life.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayata olumlu bir bakış açısı vardır.

meanings.en: a patient who receives treatment without staying overnight in hospital
meanings.exampleEn: He was treated as an outpatient and went home the same day.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayakta tedavi gören bir hasta olarak tedavi edildi ve aynı gün eve gitti.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of anger or shock
meanings.exampleEn: The decision caused public outrage across the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu karar ülke genelinde kamuoyunda büyük bir öfkeye yol açtı.

meanings.en: shocking and unacceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The prices at that restaurant are absolutely outrageous.
meanings.exampleTr: O restorandaki fiyatlar kesinlikle rezalet.

meanings.en: to be much better than someone else
meanings.exampleEn: Her performance managed to outshine everyone else on stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Performansı sahnedeki herkesi gölgede bırakmayı başardı.

meanings.en: situated on or near the outer part of something
meanings.exampleEn: The outside walls of the house need repainting.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin dış duvarlarının yeniden boyanması gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a person who does not belong to a particular group
meanings.exampleEn: As a newcomer, she felt like an outsider at first.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni geldiği için ilk başta kendini bir yabancı gibi hissetti.

meanings.en: the outer areas of a town or city
meanings.exampleEn: They live on the outskirts of the city, away from the noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Gürültüden uzak, şehrin kenar mahallelerinde yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: in a way that can be seen on the outside; in appearance
meanings.exampleEn: Outwardly she seemed calm, but inside she was nervous.
meanings.exampleTr: Görünüşte sakindi, ama içten içe gergindi.

meanings.en: having the shape of an egg or ellipse
meanings.exampleEn: The table has a large oval top.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın büyük, oval bir tablası var.

meanings.en: considering everything; total
meanings.exampleEn: The overall cost of the project was higher than expected.
meanings.exampleTr: Projenin genel maliyeti beklenenden yüksekti.

meanings.en: over the side of a boat or ship into the water
meanings.exampleEn: A sailor fell overboard during the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına sırasında bir denizci gemiden denize düştü.

meanings.en: to sell more tickets or reservations than there is space for
meanings.exampleEn: The airline tends to overbook flights during the holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Havayolu, tatil dönemlerinde uçuşlara kapasitesinden fazla rezervasyon alma eğilimindedir.

meanings.en: a long warm coat worn over other clothes
meanings.exampleEn: He put on his heavy overcoat before going out in the snow.
meanings.exampleTr: Kara çıkmadan önce kalın paltosunu giydi.

meanings.en: to give too much importance to something
meanings.exampleEn: We should not overemphasize the role of luck in his success.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısında şansın rolünü gereğinden fazla vurgulamamalıyız.

meanings.tr: fazla tahmin etmek, olduğundan fazla değer biçmek
meanings.en: to think something is larger or better than it really is
meanings.exampleEn: They overestimate the amount of time the task will take.
meanings.exampleTr: Görevin alacağı zamanı fazla tahmin ediyorlar.

meanings.en: to hear what others are saying without intending to
meanings.exampleEn: I happened to overhear their conversation in the café.
meanings.exampleTr: Kafede konuşmalarına istemeden kulak misafiri oldum.

meanings.en: a part shared by two things that partly cover the same area
meanings.exampleEn: There is a clear overlap between the two job roles.
meanings.exampleTr: İki iş rolü arasında belirgin bir örtüşme var.

meanings.en: to fail to notice or to ignore something
meanings.exampleEn: It is easy to overlook small mistakes in a long document.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun bir belgedeki küçük hataları gözden kaçırmak kolaydır.

meanings.en: too much; excessively
meanings.exampleEn: She was not overly worried about the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınav konusunda aşırı derecede endişeli değildi.

meanings.en: relating to countries across the sea; foreign
meanings.exampleEn: The company has many overseas customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin pek çok deniz aşırı müşterisi var.

meanings.en: to make something seem less important; to cast a shadow over
meanings.exampleEn: His success tends to overshadow the work of his teammates.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısı, takım arkadaşlarının çalışmalarını gölgede bırakma eğiliminde.

meanings.en: larger than the usual or standard size
meanings.exampleEn: She wore an oversize sweater that hung past her knees.
meanings.exampleTr: Dizlerini geçen, normalden büyük bir kazak giymişti.

meanings.en: to go beyond what is acceptable or allowed
meanings.exampleEn: He overstepped his authority by making the decision alone.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararı tek başına vererek yetkisinin sınırını aştı.

meanings.en: to move past someone or something by going faster
meanings.exampleEn: The red car tried to overtake the truck on the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Kırmızı araba otoyolda kamyonu sollamaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to remove a leader or government from power by force
meanings.exampleEn: The rebels tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
meanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar yozlaşmış hükümeti devirmeye çalıştılar.

meanings.en: to turn over, or to officially change a decision
meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to overturn the earlier ruling.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme önceki kararı bozmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: a bird of prey that is active at night
meanings.exampleEn: An owl hooted softly from the old oak tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı meşe ağacından bir baykuş usulca öttü.

meanings.en: a large male cattle used for pulling heavy loads
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer used an ox to plough the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi tarlayı sürmek için bir öküz kullandı.

meanings.en: a form of oxygen that forms a protective layer in the atmosphere
meanings.exampleEn: The ozone layer protects us from harmful ultraviolet rays.
meanings.exampleTr: Ozon tabakası bizi zararlı ultraviyole ışınlarından korur.

meanings.en: completely full of people or things
meanings.exampleEn: The stadium was packed with cheering fans.
meanings.exampleTr: Stadyum tezahürat yapan taraftarlarla tıka basa doluydu.

meanings.en: a small container or wrapping holding goods
meanings.exampleEn: She bought a packet of biscuits at the shop.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkândan bir paket bisküvi aldı.

meanings.en: a thick piece of soft material used for protection or comfort
meanings.exampleEn: The player wore a knee pad to protect his leg.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncu bacağını korumak için bir dizlik ped taktı.

meanings.en: a brush used for applying paint
meanings.exampleEn: He dipped the paintbrush into the blue paint.
meanings.exampleTr: Boya fırçasını mavi boyaya batırdı.

meanings.en: loose clothes worn for sleeping
meanings.exampleEn: The children put on their pajamas before bedtime.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar yatmadan önce pijamalarını giydiler.

meanings.en: a flat wooden platform used for storing or moving goods
meanings.exampleEn: The boxes were stacked neatly on a wooden pallet.
meanings.exampleTr: Kutular ahşap bir paletin üzerine düzgünce istiflenmişti.

meanings.en: a thin flat cake made from batter and fried in a pan
meanings.exampleEn: We had pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltıda akçaağaç şuruplu krep yedik.

meanings.en: (of a disease) spread over a whole country or the world
meanings.exampleEn: The government prepared for a possible pandemic outbreak.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet olası bir pandemik salgın için hazırlık yaptı.

meanings.en: a group of people who discuss or decide something, or a flat board
meanings.exampleEn: A panel of experts answered questions from the audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir uzmanlar paneli izleyicilerin sorularını yanıtladı.

meanings.en: a tropical fruit with orange flesh and black seeds
meanings.exampleEn: For dessert we ate a ripe, juicy papaya.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatlı olarak olgun, sulu bir papaya yedik.

meanings.en: using electronic systems instead of paper
meanings.exampleEn: The company switched to a paperless office to save trees.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, ağaçları korumak için kâğıtsız bir ofise geçti.

meanings.en: the written work such as forms and documents needed for a task
meanings.exampleEn: There is a lot of paperwork to complete before you can travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahat edebilmen için tamamlanması gereken çok fazla evrak işi var.

meanings.en: a public procession celebrating a special day or event
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of people watched the colorful street parade.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce kişi renkli sokak geçit törenini izledi.

meanings.en: a statement that seems contradictory but may be true
meanings.exampleEn: It is a paradox that the more we learn, the less we seem to know.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne kadar çok öğrenirsek o kadar az bildiğimizi hissetmemiz bir paradokstur.

meanings.en: the loss of the ability to move part of the body
meanings.exampleEn: The accident left him with paralysis in both legs.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza, her iki bacağında felç bıraktı.

meanings.en: a person trained to give medical help in an emergency
meanings.exampleEn: The paramedic arrived quickly and treated the injured driver.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlık görevlisi hızla geldi ve yaralı sürücüyü tedavi etti.

meanings.en: a soldier trained to jump from aircraft using a parachute
meanings.exampleEn: The paratrooper jumped from the plane into enemy territory.
meanings.exampleTr: Paraşütçü asker uçaktan düşman bölgesine atladı.

meanings.en: the group of elected people who make a country's laws
meanings.exampleEn: The new law was approved by parliament last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa geçen hafta parlamento tarafından onaylandı.

meanings.en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher encouraged active participation in class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınıfta etkin katılımı teşvik etti.

meanings.en: a very small piece or amount of something
meanings.exampleEn: Tiny particles of dust floated in the sunlight.
meanings.exampleTr: Minik toz parçacıkları güneş ışığında süzülüyordu.
